{{Quote|The virus has escaped the facility and ravaged a good portion of Dathomir.|A spacer, to Dr. [[Griffax Jin]]|<ref name="SWG:WN" />}}
A [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] '''outbreak''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after an accident in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility|research facility]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The Galactic Empire [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|quarantined]] the area and spacers intervened to help the survivors and join the fight against the [[Zombie/Legends|undeads]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Chewie and I had an 'experience' with this virus before. It was called Blackwing. The virus wiped out a star destroyer as well as a prison ship. Nasty stuff.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMR" />}}
The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] was an infectious viral agent that turned its victims into flesh-craving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. It was originally created as a means of [[Immortality/Legends|becoming immortal]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Drear]] using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="Red Harvest">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>

[[File:Aboard_the_Vector.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The decapitated head of a stormtrooper during the [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']] outbreak.]]
Thousands of years later, the virus was finally recovered by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Vader commissioned the [[Imperial Biological Weapons Division]] to re-engineer the virus and turn it into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> His objective&mdash;or at least his objective as known to other members of the project&mdash;was to use the virus to create super [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> Vader himself, however, had long been fascinated by powers relating to staving off death, owing to the demise of his beloved wife [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> The project was secretly carried aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']]. However, in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the virus was accidentally unleashed aboard the ''Vector'', and later in the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], turning all of the personnel into violent undeads. The sole survivors who eventually succeed in escaping the outbreak were [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zahara Cody]], [[chief medical officer]] of the ''Purge'', the prisoner [[Trig Longo]], and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="DT" />

[[File:Imperial_Research_and_Prison_Facility.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]
After the ''Vector'' incident, the project was not canceled but relocated to a secret [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the remote planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The Empire recruited high profile scientists from all around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to participate in the project.<ref name="SWG:ID" /> Dr. [[Griffax Jin]] served as chief virologist. Other scientists included Dr. [[Pram Dramango]], Dr. [[Stane Tritan]], Dr. [[Nomi Rhane]], Dr. [[Piodas Ray]], Dr. [[Tare Sal]], Dr. [[Ziris Enz]], [[Marpo Glenfik]], [[Skrat Horle]],<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> and [[Tyla Gallamby]].<ref name="SWG:ID" /> Security personnel included [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lenders Ennada]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Flinn Boster]], [[Arwen Zherooh]] and [[Jecht Eris]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[TK-217]], [[BT-413]], [[DS-378]], [[TK-108]], [[FR-351]],<ref name="SWG:RFL1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Research Facility, Level 1|Dathomir}}</ref> [[GT-643]], [[KD-121]] and [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> Other staff included [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]],<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> prison guards [[Torkin Doha]] and [[Derin Hans]], [[Beastmaster/Legends|creature handlers]] [[Tyris Santorini]] and [[Yerkys Neir]], and maintenance worker [[Pit Cornburr]].<ref name="SWG:RFL1" />

At some point, one of the scientists involved in project provided the virus to the biologist [[Derg Prantis]], chief-scientist of the [[Mos Eisley Biolab]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The biologist therefore built a [[Secret Laboratory|secret laboratory]] on the remote planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] to conduct his own research on the virus. However, Prantis was later betrayed by his lab assistant [[Bera Jeza]] who contacted [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to sell him the super soldier drug.<ref name="SWG:TP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Plan|Tatooine}}</ref> Nevertheless, Prantis and Jeza were assassinated,<ref name="SWG:BJE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bera Jeza's Employer|Tatooine}}</ref> as well as the entire staff of Derg Prantis' secret lab.<ref name="SWG:FC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Clues|Lok}}</ref>

==The outbreak==
{{Quote|The virus somehow escaped. It was probably an accident.''"<br />"''The virus?''"<br />"''Everyone was dying! I ran away on foot before they turned into...whatever. Whatever it was going to be, it wasn't going to be a super soldier...more like a horror soldier.|[[Tyla Gallamby]] and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ID" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> an accident happened in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility and the virus escaped containment another time. Again, the virus killed most of the people in the area and turned them into hungry zombies.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />
[[File:Quarantine_Zone_zombies_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Zombie/Legends|Undeads]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]].]]
In place of sterilizing the area with an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], the Empire promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The area was surrounded by a tall fortified wall and its access was defended by a contingent of stormtroopers commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Liam Waurie]].<ref name="SWG:GI" /> Very few people who survived the initial virus outbreak managed to escape the lockdown, among them were Tyla Gallamby, stormtrooper [[Tk-216]], and [[Illrian Nhagy]]<ref name="SWG:ID" /> The other survivors, mostly Imperial staff and prisoners, were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. They established five camps inside the area, [[Camp Alpha]], [[Camp Beta]], [[Camp Gamma]], [[Camp Delta]] and [[Camp Epsilon]], to try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:CLC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Camp Location Collection}}</ref> These survivors included [[Stephon Sprocketfire]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mika Horn]], [[Kyra 'Naa]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Erlem Marh]], [[Zsu Val]],<ref name="SWG:FW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Forward Watch}}</ref> [[Volo Madine]], [[TIE pilot]] [[Jeb Maris]], [[Tripp D'jek]], stormtrooper [[TR-522]], [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> [[Oona Wran]],<ref name="SWG:QZVCD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Quarantine Zone Virus Container Demolition}}</ref> stormtroopers HX-138, KD-121 and GT-643,<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> [[Nils Cridmeen]],<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref> and Inquisitor Klex Fulgor.<ref name="SWG:AA" /> The camps all came under regular attack from the zombies.<ref name="SWG:FW" /> Moreover, all rescue teams were attacked upon landing in the area and their members were killed before they could find the survivors.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> Landing in the Quarantine Zone was eventually prohibited<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> and Imperial authorities only tried to support the survivors with supply air drop.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

The Rebel Alliance discovered the accident in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility almost as quickly as the Empire itself. Immediately after the outbreak, before the establishment of the Quarantine Zone, a small unit of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troops]] landed near the Imperial Research and Prison Facility to investigate the place and rescue survivors. However, the Rebel forces were soon attacked by undead stormtroopers and were forced to withdraw. They suffered heavy casualties but managed to retreat to their extraction point. Nonetheless, when some Rebel soldiers started to display symptoms of the sickness, the evacuation mission was aborted and the few remaining Rebels were stuck in the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:TD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Tripp D'jek|Dathomir}}</ref>

[[File:Zahara_Cody_Trig_Longo_SWG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Zahara Cody]] and [[Trig Longo]] in [[Camp Alpha]].]]
Doctor Zahara Cody and Trig Longo, the survivors from the ''Purge'', soon arrived on Dathomir and were dropped in Camp Alpha from the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] by Han Solo and Chewbacca.<ref name="SWG:StT" /> Cody and Longo had decided to distribute to the survivors of the Quarantine Zone an anti-virus developed by Dr. Cody during the ''Vector'' incident from her own immunity.<ref name="SWG:GI" />

In the meantime, the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Cale Herron]] was investigating the disappearance of the scientists<ref name="SWG:FCH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Cale Herron|Tatooine}}</ref> employed by the Empire to work on the Blackwing virus project.<ref name="SWG:ID" /> After the assassination of the biologists Derg Prantis and Bera Jeza in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], he received the support of a group of spacers who assisted him in his investigation.<ref name="SWG:FCH" /> In Derg Prantis' lab on Lok,<ref name="SWG:FC" /> the spacers found the genetic sequence of the virus,<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> but they did not realize the importance of their discovery.<ref name="SWG:FC" /> Nevertheless, their investigation finally led them to the discovery of the virus outbreak on Dathomir. When the spacers arrived on Dathomir, the area was already quarantined by the Empire.<ref name="SWG:ID" />

==The mission to the Imperial Research and Prison Facility==
{{Quote|You are to travel to the Research and Prison Facility and gain entrance to the primary research lab there. Inside you are to locate at least one sample of a chemical named 'Blackwing.' You have a secondary mission of destroying the virus.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMR" />}}
Imperial operations in the Quarantine Zone were supervised by Darth Vader himself. In fact, the Dark Lord was not eager to lose the virus and the research data. He therefore ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] to recruit volunteers in order to enter the quarantine zone and obtain a sample of the virus in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility. In the meantime, the situation was discovered by the Rebel Alliance and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. Han Solo was tasked by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to contact Rebel agents and convince them to enter the Quarantine Zone to get the virus before the Empire. On the other hand, [[Guri]], the lieutenant of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the Black Sun, traveled to the Quarantine Zone as well and recruited unaligned adventurers to find the virus for Xizor. Both the Rebellion and the Black Sun had managed to steal Imperial authorization codes, allowing their agents to enter the Zone.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

[[File:Sick_troops.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A group of undead stormtroopers in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.]]

Once in the Quarantine Zone, all those spacers had to fight against an extensive amount of aggressive undeads. The undeads included Imperial soldiers and prisoners from the Imperial Research and Prison Facility as well as indigenous Dathomiri [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]]. The spacers fought and killed a large number of Individuals reanimated by the virus, including [[Fenn Kay'lay]], [[Vil Burren]], [[Jawiin Danod]], [[Salek Panaka]], [[Snotharr]], [[Navik Geelo]], [[Dugo Evnul]], [[Adol Mantid]], [[Tal Freykaa]], [[Kallaova]], [[Soon Dom]], [[Ool Awmod]], [[Jaina Nassin]], [[Wertsnik]], [[Wesk Kit'pay]], [[Ghianna Hayde]], [[Chak Krist]], [[Treena Moldovia]], [[Vina Maljazara]], and Pit Cornburr.<ref name="SWG:UB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Undead Boss}}</ref>

[[File:RancorZombie.png|thumb|right|200px|Spacers fighting the [[undead rancor]].]]
The spacers later reached the Camp Epsilon in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility were they found a contingent of immune stormtroopers led by HX-138.<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> The spacers helped the stormtroopers to repair a damaged [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] and therefore obtained their support in finding the virus in the Research Facility.<ref name="SWG:StT" /> The spacers then entered the Research Facility itself where they were attacked by the most aggressive undead creatures.<ref name="SWG:WN" /> They even had to fight a giant [[undead rancor]] in the depths of the Facility.<ref name="SWG:GEUR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Group Event - Undead Rancor|Dathomir}}</ref> Finally, the spacers found the chief virologist, Dr. Griffax Jin, who was still alive. However, the man was infected by the virus and soon turned into a zombie and attacked the spacers. After the scientist was definitely killed, one of the spacers managed to get a sample of the original virus in the lab. The spacers also encountered some survivors, including TK-217, Marpo Glenfik, Dr. Pram Dramango, Dr. Stane Tritan, Dr. Griffax Jin and Dr. Nomi Rhane.<ref name="SWG:WN" /> The spacers helped them to shut down the facility ventilation in order to stop the spread of the virus outside the research center.<ref name="SWG:SV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Stupid Vents!|Dathomir}}</ref> The survivors and the spacer then used an emergency escape ladder to leave the facility. The spacers escorted the survivors to Camp Epsilon nearby, where a group of refugees, including HX-138 and her troops, were awaiting them. The survivors from the research facility, the spacers and the refugees of Camp Epsilon eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone together in the repaired ''Lambda''-class shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|In their misguided attempts to contain this plague they sought to eradicate any trace of it's contagion. They believed my clan tainted by such a trace.|[[Amaya Kymeri]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GU19" />}}
The Empire eventually succeed in containing the spread of the virus. Since some Witches of Dathomir were contaminated by the Blackwing virus during the crisis, Imperial forces targeted the Witches living in the neighborhood of the Quarantine Zone and exterminated most of the [[Howling Crag Clan]]. However three of the infected witches, [[Denkra Kymeri|Denkra]], [[Naija Kymeri|Naija]] and [[Thestriel Kymeri]], survived by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to fight off the contagion and learned to control the virus. They became known as the [[Sisters of the Void]].<ref name="SWG:GU19" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Blackwing virus outbreak was first mentioned in the game during the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:ID" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]", on [[September 30]], [[2009]],<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> introducing the upcoming [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" content]] of ''Star Wars Galaxies''. The Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir was the main addition of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," released on [[October 12]], 2009.<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref> This update was developed in conjunction with [[Joe Schreiber]]'s novel, ''[[Death Troopers]]''.<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – An Inside Look At ''Death Troopers''">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68512&month=112009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; An Inside Look At ''Death Troopers''}}</ref>
